title: Name spaceId on cleared space binding; check channel in Space
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Name spaceId on cleared space binding; check channel in Space
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L1074: "the server SHOULD verify ... that a non-null `channelId` is a channel of the Space named by `spaceId`. ... an update that sets `spaceId` to `null` while `accessPolicy` is `\"space\"` fails with `invalidProperties` naming `spaceId`."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/region.rs:334-339; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/region.rs:346-377; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/backend.rs:257-266
Now: capability_errors names `accessPolicy` when spaceId is null under accessPolicy "space". region_binding(property, id) checks each binding on its own and cannot verify that channelId belongs to spaceId.
Change: Push "spaceId" (instead of, or in addition to, accessPolicy) when spaceId is null and the policy is space. Add a channel-in-space check: extend region_binding with the spaceId, or add a backend hook, and fail with invalidProperties naming channelId.
